<finding task="2"><quote>`exclude-newer` set to the RFC 3339 timestamp of 00:00:00Z on the day after the freeze date</quote><plan>return f'{self.freeze:%Y-%m-%d}T00:00:00Z'</plan><fix>Return 00:00:00Z on `freeze + timedelta(days=1)`. Change `test_cutoff_is_midnight_utc_on_the_freeze_date` to expect '2026-10-20T00:00:00Z' and '2027-01-01T00:00:00Z', and rename it. Update the `uv.toml` comment written by `outputs()` so it says that files uploaded on the freeze date are included. Update every test that spells the cutoff, in Tasks 5, 7 and 8. Without this, `late_pins` (`uploaded >= cutoff`) refuses a pin uploaded on the freeze date itself, which R2.1 says is included.</fix></finding>
